obstruction.description: The caption is placed at the top of the frame, well above the bag's interior. The presenter overlay is located in the bottom-right corner over the wood-textured background. Neither overlay obstructs the view of the wide slip pocket or the hand gesture holding the bag open.

captions.description: The caption text (white text on a black background) remains consistently centered and is easily readable throughout its appearance.

lip_sync.description: The presenter's mouth movements are properly synchronized with the audible speech throughout the video.

visual_defects.description: No concrete visual defects such as video stutter, compression artifacts, or glitches were observed.
